    (i : Usize) (h : acl.direct_grant_exists_loop db types ids .Share r now i = ok true) : OwnerLive db now := by
  unfold acl.direct_grant_exists_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun _ => True) (fun b => b = true → OwnerLive db now) (fun j => db.grants.length - j.val)
    ?_ i true trivial h rfl
  intro j res _ hb
  unfold acl.direct_grant_exists_loop.body at hb
  h5i_invert hb
  all_goals dsimp only
  all_goals first
    | (refine ⟨trivial, incr_lt ?_ ‹_›⟩; scalar_tac)
    | (intro; exact ⟨_, index_mem ‹_›, role_implies_share ‹_› ‹_›, live_ok ‹_› ‹_›⟩)
    | simp


theorem folder_loop (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (now : I64) (target : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (i : Usize) (h : acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop db types ids .Share now target i = ok true) :
    OwnerLive db now := by
  unfold acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop at h

    ?_ i true trivial h rfl

  h5i_invert hb
  all_goals dsimp only
  all_goals first

    | (intro; exact ⟨_, index_mem ‹_›, role_implies_share ‹_› ‹_›, live_ok ‹_› ‹_›⟩)

theorem folder_exists (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (fid : U64) (now : I64)
    (h : acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists db types ids .Share fid now = ok true) : OwnerLive db now := by

theorem stronger_owner {a : Option model.Role} {b : model.Role}
    (h : acl.stronger a b = ok (some .Owner)) : a = some .Owner ∨ b = .Owner := by
  unfold acl.stronger at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals simp_all

theorem caller_loop (db : model.Db) (d : U64) (now : I64) (types : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (ids : alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (best : Option model.Role) (i : Usize)
    (hb : best = some .Owner → OwnerLive db now)
    (h : acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop db d now types ids best i = ok (some .Owner)) : OwnerLive db now := by
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop at h
  refine loop_ok _ (fun x => x.1 = some .Owner → OwnerLive db now) (fun o => o = some .Owner → OwnerLive db now)
    (fun x => db.grants.length - x.2.val) ?_ (best, i) _ hb h rfl
  rintro ⟨b0, j⟩ res hinv hs
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop.body at hs
  simp only [H5iAppLib.bind_ite] at hs
  h5i_invert hs
  all_goals dsimp only at hinv ⊢
  · rename_i hlt g hidx _ _ _ best1 hrest w hw
    refine ⟨?_, incr_lt (by scalar_tac) hw⟩
    obtain ⟨a, -, hx⟩ := hrest
    split at hx
    · obtain ⟨b2, hl, hx⟩ := bind_tc_eq_ok.1 hx
      split at hx
      · intro ho; subst ho
        rcases stronger_owner hx with h' | h'
        · exact hinv h'
        · exact ⟨g, index_mem hidx, h', live_ok hl ‹_›⟩
      · simp at hx; subst hx; exact hinv
    · simp at hx; subst hx; exact hinv
  · rename_i best1 hb1 w hw
    subst hb1
    exact ⟨hinv, incr_lt (by scalar_tac) hw⟩
  · exact hinv

theorem role_has_share {o : Option model.Role} (h : acl.role_has o .Share = ok true) : o = some .Owner := by
  unfold acl.role_has at h
  split at h
  · simp at h
  · rename_i r
    cases r <;> simp_all [acl.role_grants, model.Permission.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqPermission.eq,
      model.Permission.read_discriminant]

theorem caller_owner (db : model.Db) (s : model.Subject) (d : U64) (now : I64) (o : Option model.Role)
    (h1 : acl.caller_role_on_drive db s d now = ok o) (h2 : acl.role_has o .Share = ok true) :
    OwnerLive db now := by
  have := role_has_share h2; subst this
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive at h1
  h5i_invert h1
  exact caller_loop _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (by simp) h1

theorem cascade_owner (db : model.Db) (s : model.Subject) (r : model.Resource) (now : I64)
    (h : acl.cascade_grant db s r .Share now = ok true) : OwnerLive db now := by
  unfold acl.cascade_grant at h
  h5i_invert h
  · rename_i w _
    obtain ⟨t, i⟩ := w
    exact folder_exists _ _ _ _ _ h
  · rename_i o _ b hb hbt
    subst hbt
    split at hb
    · simp at hb
    · h5i_invert hb
      rename_i w _
      obtain ⟨t, i⟩ := w
      exact folder_exists _ _ _ _ _ hb
  · rename_i w _
    obtain ⟨t, i⟩ := w
    exact direct_loop _ _ _ _ _ _ h

theorem direct_pair {db : model.Db} {r : model.Resource} {now : I64} (w : alloc.vec.Vec U8 × alloc.vec.Vec U64)
    (h : (let (types, ids) := w
      acl.direct_grant_exists db types.deref ids.deref .Share r now) = ok true) : OwnerLive db now := by
  obtain ⟨t, i⟩ := w
  exact direct_loop _ _ _ _ _ _ h

theorem caller_owner' {db : model.Db} {s : model.Subject} {d : U64} {now : I64} {o : Option model.Role}
    (h2 : acl.role_has o .Share = ok true) (h1 : acl.caller_role_on_drive db s d now = ok o) :
    OwnerLive db now := caller_owner db s d now o h1 h2

theorem share_needs_owner (db : model.Db) (ro : Bool) (now : I64) (s : model.Subject) (r : model.Resource)
    (h : acl.check db ro now s .Share r = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now := by
  unfold acl.check at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals subst_vars
  all_goals first
    | exact caller_owner' ‹_› ‹_›
    | exact cascade_owner _ _ _ _ ‹_›
    | exact direct_pair _ h

end oxicloud_kernel.Solution

theorem usize_add_one_step (x w : Usize) (n : Nat) (hx : x.val < n) (h : x + 1#usize = ok w) :
    w.val ≤ n ∧ n - w.val < n - x.val := by
  have he := UScalar.add_equiv x 1#usize
  rw [h, Result.match.ok] at he
  have : (1#usize).val = 1 := rfl
  omega

theorem direct_grant_exists_loop_ok (db : model.Db) (types : Slice Std.U8) (ids : Slice Std.U64)
    (r : model.Resource) (now : Std.I64) (i : Std.Usize) (hi : i.val ≤ db.grants.val.length)
    (h : acl.direct_grant_exists_loop db types ids .Share r now i = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now := by
  have hloop : (fun b => b = true → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now) true := by
    apply loop_ok (body := fun i1 => acl.direct_grant_exists_loop.body db types ids .Share r now i1)
      (Inv := fun j => j.val ≤ db.grants.val.length)
      (Q := fun b => b = true → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now)
      (μ := fun j => db.grants.val.length - j.val)
      _ i true hi h
    intro x res hx hstep
    unfold acl.direct_grant_exists_loop.body at hstep
    h5i_invert hstep
    · intro _
      subst_vars
      have hr := ‹acl.role_implies _ model.Permission.Share = ok true›
      rw [role_implies_share] at hr
      simp only [ok.injEq, decide_eq_true_eq] at hr
      have hl := ‹acl.live _ now = ok true›
      rw [live_iff] at hl
      have hmem := vec_index_mem db.grants x _ ‹alloc.vec.Vec.index _ db.grants x = ok _›
      exact ⟨_, hmem, hr, hl⟩
    · exact usize_add_one_step x _ db.grants.val.length (by scalar_tac) ‹x + 1#usize = ok _›
    · exact usize_add_one_step x _ db.grants.val.length (by scalar_tac) ‹x + 1#usize = ok _›
    · exact usize_add_one_step x _ db.grants.val.length (by scalar_tac) ‹x + 1#usize = ok _›
    · exact usize_add_one_step x _ db.grants.val.length (by scalar_tac) ‹x + 1#usize = ok _›
    · intro hy; contradiction
  exact hloop rfl

theorem drive_role_step (drive_id : Std.U64) (now : Std.I64)
    (best : Option model.Role) (g : model.Grant) (b : Bool) (best1 : Option model.Role)
    (h : (if b
          then do
            let b1 ← model.Resource.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqResource.eq g.resource (model.Resource.Drive drive_id)
            if b1
            then
              let b2 ← acl.live g now
              if b2
              then acl.stronger best g.role
              else ok best
            else ok best
          else ok best) = ok best1)
    (hbest1 : best1 = some .Owner) :
    best = some .Owner ∨ (g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now) := by
  split at h
  · h5i_invert h
    · subst hbest1
      have hstr := stronger_owner best g.role ‹acl.stronger best g.role = ok (some .Owner)›
      cases hstr with
      | inl h_new =>
        subst_vars
        have hl := ‹acl.live g now = ok true›
        rw [live_iff] at hl
        right; exact ⟨h_new, hl⟩
      | inr h_old => left; exact h_old
    · left; subst_vars; rfl
    · left; subst_vars; rfl
  · left; simp only [ok.injEq] at h; rw [h, hbest1]

theorem caller_role_on_drive_loop_ok (db : model.Db) (drive_id : Std.U64) (now : Std.I64)
    (types : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (ids : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U64)
    (best : Option model.Role) (i : Std.Usize)
    (hinv : best = some .Owner → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now)
    (hi : i.val ≤ db.grants.val.length)
    (res : Option model.Role)
    (h : acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop db drive_id now types ids best i = ok res)
    (hres : res = some .Owner) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now := by
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop at h
  have hloop : (fun r => r = some .Owner → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now) res := by
    apply loop_ok (body := fun (b, j) => acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop.body db drive_id now types ids b j)
      (Inv := fun (b, j) => (b = some .Owner → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now) ∧ j.val ≤ db.grants.val.length)
      (Q := fun r => r = some .Owner → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now)
      (μ := fun (_, j) => db.grants.val.length - j.val)
      _ (best, i) res ⟨hinv, hi⟩ h
    intro (b, j) r ⟨hinv_j, hj⟩ hstep
    unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop.body at hstep
    h5i_invert hstep
    · dsimp only
      have hstep_add := usize_add_one_step j _ db.grants.val.length (by scalar_tac) ‹j + 1#usize = ok _›
      refine ⟨⟨?_, hstep_add.1⟩, hstep_add.2⟩
      intro h_owner
      have hmem := vec_index_mem db.grants j _ ‹alloc.vec.Vec.index _ db.grants j = ok _›
      have hstep_role := drive_role_step drive_id now b _ _ _ ‹_ = ok _› h_owner
      cases hstep_role with
      | inl h_old => exact hinv_j h_old
      | inr h_new => exact ⟨_, hmem, h_new.1, h_new.2⟩
    · exact hinv_j
  exact hloop hres

theorem caller_role_on_drive_ok (db : model.Db) (s : model.Subject) (drive_id : Std.U64) (now : Std.I64)
    (res : Option model.Role)
    (h : acl.caller_role_on_drive db s drive_id now = ok res)
    (hres : res = some .Owner) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now := by
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive at h
  h5i_invert h
  exact caller_role_on_drive_loop_ok db drive_id now _ _ none 0#usize (by intro; contradiction) (by scalar_tac) res (by assumption) hres

theorem cascade_grant_ok (db : model.Db) (s : model.Subject) (r : model.Resource) (now : Std.I64)
    (h : acl.cascade_grant db s r .Share now = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now := by
  cases r with
  | Folder id =>
    unfold acl.cascade_grant at h
    h5i_invert h
    exact folder_cascade_grant_exists_ok db _ _ id now ‹_›
  | File id =>
    unfold acl.cascade_grant at h
    simp only [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
    rcases h with ⟨o, h_o, h⟩
    cases o with
    | none =>
      dsimp only at h
      h5i_invert h
      · subst_vars; contradiction
      · rcases ‹alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8 × alloc.vec.Vec Std.U64› with ⟨types, ids⟩
        exact direct_grant_exists_ok db _ _ (model.Resource.File id) now ‹_›
    | some parent =>
      dsimp only at h
      simp only [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
      rcases h with ⟨b, hb, h⟩
      split at h
      · h5i_invert hb
        rcases ‹alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8 × alloc.vec.Vec Std.U64› with ⟨types, ids⟩
        subst_vars
        exact folder_cascade_grant_exists_ok db _ _ parent now hb
      · h5i_invert h
        rcases ‹alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8 × alloc.vec.Vec Std.U64› with ⟨types, ids⟩
        exact direct_grant_exists_ok db _ _ (model.Resource.File id) now ‹_›
  | Drive _ => unfold acl.cascade_grant at h; simp only [ok.injEq] at h; contradiction
  | Calendar _ => unfold acl.cascade_grant at h; simp only [ok.injEq] at h; contradiction
  | AddressBook _ => unfold acl.cascade_grant at h; simp only [ok.injEq] at h; contradiction
  | Playlist _ => unfold acl.cascade_grant at h; simp only [ok.injEq] at h; contradiction

theorem share_needs_owner (db : model.Db) (ro : Bool) (now : I64) (s : model.Subject) (r : model.Resource)
    (h : acl.check db ro now s .Share r = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now := by
  unfold acl.check at h
  rw [read_only_gate_applies_share] at h
  h5i_invert h
  all_goals try subst_vars
  all_goals try contradiction
  all_goals try (
    rcases ‹alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8 × alloc.vec.Vec Std.U64› with ⟨types, ids⟩
    exact direct_grant_exists_ok db _ _ _ now ‹_›
  )
  all_goals try (
    exact cascade_grant_ok db s _ now ‹_›
  )
  all_goals try (
    have h_own := (role_has_share _).1 ‹acl.role_has _ .Share = ok true›
    exact caller_role_on_drive_ok db s _ now _ ‹acl.caller_role_on_drive db s _ now = ok _› h_own
  )

end oxicloud_kernel.Solution

theorem cascade_grant_owner (db : model.Db) (s : model.Subject) (r : model.Resource) (now : Std.I64)
    (h : acl.cascade_grant db s r .Share now = ok true) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now := by
  unfold acl.cascade_grant at h
  cases r with
  | Folder id =>
    rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨⟨types, ids⟩, _, h⟩ := h
    exact folder_cascade_grant_exists_owner db (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) id now h
  | File id =>
    rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨o, ho, h⟩ := h
    cases o with
    | none =>
      dsimp only at h
      rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
      obtain ⟨fa, hfa, h⟩ := h
      obtain rfl : fa = false := by simpa using hfa.symm
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at h
      rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨types, ids⟩, _, h⟩ := h
      exact direct_grant_exists_owner db (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) (model.Resource.File id) now h
    | some parent =>
      dsimp only at h
      rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
      obtain ⟨fa, hfa, h⟩ := h
      cases fa with
      | true =>
        simp only [if_true] at h
        rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at hfa
        obtain ⟨⟨types, ids⟩, _, hfa⟩ := hfa
        exact folder_cascade_grant_exists_owner db (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) parent now hfa
      | false =>
        simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at h
        rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
        obtain ⟨⟨types, ids⟩, _, h⟩ := h
        exact direct_grant_exists_owner db (alloc.vec.Vec.deref types) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref ids) (model.Resource.File id) now h
  | Drive id => simp at h
  | Calendar id => simp at h
  | AddressBook id => simp at h
  | Playlist id => simp at h



theorem stronger_some {a : Option model.Role} {b r : model.Role}
    (h : acl.stronger a b = ok (some r)) : a = some r ∨ b = r := by
  unfold acl.stronger at h
  cases a with
  | none => simp at h; exact Or.inr h
  | some x =>
    dsimp only at h
    rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨rb, hrb, h⟩ := h
    rw [bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
    obtain ⟨rx, hrx, h⟩ := h
    split at h
    · simp at h; exact Or.inr h
    · simp at h; exact Or.inl (by rw [h])

theorem caller_role_on_drive_loop_owner (db : model.Db) (drive_id : Std.U64) (now : Std.I64)
    (types : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U8) (ids : alloc.vec.Vec Std.U64)
    (h : acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop db drive_id now types ids none 0#usize = ok (some .Owner)) :
    ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now := by
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop at h
  have hmain := loop_ok (fun st : Option model.Role × Std.Usize =>
        acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop.body db drive_id now types ids st.1 st.2)
      (fun st => st.1 = some .Owner → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now)
      (fun best => best = some .Owner → ∃ g ∈ db.grants.val, g.role = .Owner ∧ Live g now)
      (fun st : Option model.Role × Std.Usize => db.grants.val.length - st.2.val)
      ?_ (none, 0#usize) (some .Owner) (by simp) h
  · exact hmain rfl
  · intro st rr hinv hb
    obtain ⟨best, i⟩ := st
    cases rr with
    | done y =>
      unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop.body at hb
      h5i_invert hb
      dsimp only
      exact hinv
    | cont x' =>
      obtain ⟨best', i'⟩ := x'
      unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop.body at hb
      h5i_invert hb
      rename_i hlen g hg b hsm bestif hi2
      dsimp only
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro hbest
        h5i_invert bestif
        · rename_i hbtrue ev1 heq1 v1 lv hlv hv
          rw [hbest] at bestif
          rcases stronger_some bestif with hbest' | hgrole
          · exact hinv hbest'
          · refine ⟨g, ?_, hgrole, ?_⟩
            · have h1 : alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize db.grants i = ok g := by
                simpa [alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index] using hg
              have h2 := post_of_ok (alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize_spec db.grants i (by simpa using hlen)) h1
              rw [h2]; exact List.getElem_mem (by simpa using hlen)
            · exact live_iff.mp (hlv.trans (by rw [hv]))
        all_goals exact hinv hbest
      · have hx : i'.val = i.val + 1 := usize_add_one_val (by assumption)
        have hlen2 : i.val < db.grants.val.length := by
          have h := (by assumption : i < db.grants.len); simpa using h
        simp only [hx]; omega
